name: Ming's Wok
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ming’s Wok in Oberammergau**

Discover authentic Asian flavors in the heart of the **Alps**! At **Ming’s Wok**, you’ll find a cozy spot in **Oberammergau**, where delicious **Szechuan** dishes, fresh **sushi**, and aromatic **wok** creations await. Whether you crave spicy **Dan Dan noodles**, tender **Kung Pao chicken**, or crispy **spring rolls**, our menu offers something for every palate.

Come enjoy a taste of the **Far East** in this picturesque Bavarian village—just a short drive from **Garmisch-Partenkirchen** and the stunning **Zugspitze**. Warm hospitality and mouthwatering aromas make **Ming’s Wok** the perfect escape after a day of hiking or sightseeing in the **Ammergau Alps**.

**Reservations recommended!** 🍜✨
